Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 42 Camperdown North

Clause 9.42.1 - heritage (heritage_protection): The most notable building within the precinct is the ‘Australia Street industrial group’ heritage item located between Denison Street and Australia Street.

Clause 9.42.1 - setback (development_control): Most buildings are built to the street with a nil setback.

Clause 9.42.1 - parking (development_control): Some of the industrial units in Hordern Place have a small setback with parking in front.

Clause 9.42.1 - parking (development_control): Parking within the precinct is generally unrestricted where available and appears highly utilised.

Clause 9.42.2 - other (heritage_protection): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.42.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.42.2 - land_use_zoning (land_use_zoning): To retain the existing employment generating landuses.

Clause 9.42.2 - other (development_control): To facilitate efficient parking, loading and access for vehicles that minimises impact to streetscape appearance, commercial viability and vitality and pedestrian safety and amenity.
